title: The record-edit refusal reads a comment id built by the shell
why: A comment id given as `$(cmd)`, `$((..))` or `${ID:-x}` slips past the edit refusal in hooks/guard.py `_ROUTE_NUMBER`; the remedy says to write the number literally (coordinator, 11:03 CST Nov 8). The lane also checks whether #1751 covers a hand-written record posted by `gh pr comment`, and asks for a step if not.
